---
name: Proposal
about: Propose a policy, runtime, installer, or compatibility improvement
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem and risk

What coding-agent failure or maintainer burden should this address?

## Proposed invariant

What must remain true, where should it be enforced, and how should it fail?

## Verification

How can the behavior be reproduced or tested?

## Scope and tradeoffs

Which components or environments are affected? Could this weaken an existing
guarantee (fail-soft hooks, record integrity, installer backups)?
